name: Open Exchange
description: Swap 1Color tokens against the pools on this exchange, and deploy and close liquidity positions.

groupPermissions.description: Open Exchange builds swaps and pools with your wallet, holds the tokens and sats on their way into a swap, receives the sats pools pay you, and delivers a send to a handle; the list of your tokens and their amounts is read once through your wallet's 1Color module (granted here); sending tokens, and the exact balance of one token, the module asks you about itself.

protocolPermissions.description: Derive one-time keys for the sats pools pay you, and for your LP position (BRC-29 payments to yourself).
Derive the key of each pool you deploy and the fees it pays you, asked once.
Derive one-time keys for the tokens held in the swap basket, and sign the swap legs that spend them.
Show which wallet is connected and name it as the sender of payments to yourself.
Create and check the session nonces of authenticated requests to the overlay instance.
Sign authenticated requests to the overlay instance (asked once per instance, on first use).
Sign the delivery envelope of a token you send to a BRC-169 handle.
Encrypt the delivery of a token you send to a BRC-169 handle so only the recipient can read it.
Label the swaps you build, their funding and their payouts so they are listed together in your wallet.
Label the action that sets aside the tokens and sats a swap needs, so a token set aside is found again if the page closes.
Label the pools you create so they are listed together in your wallet.
Label the positions you close so they are listed together in your wallet.
Label the pool payouts your wallet takes in so they are listed together.
Mark a token send as held for the recipient until it expires.

basketAccess.description: File the tokens and the sats sent into the swap basket for your swap legs, spend them in the legs, and move the tokens back into your wallet.
File and read the pools you hold as LP, and drop one when you close it.
File the fees your pools pay you, and spend them when you collect.
List the 1Color tokens this wallet holds and their amounts (the wallet's 1Color module). The exact balance of one token is asked when you open it.
Read your wallet's sats balance (shown under the amount you pay).
